questions.question: What does Psalm 149 call God's people to do?
options: Bow before the LORD in silence and wait upon his word
Sing to the LORD a new song and praise his name with dancing
Weep before the LORD in sackcloth and confess your sins
Bring to the LORD your many offerings and lay them on the altar
questions.answer: Sing to the LORD a new song and praise his name with dancing

questions.question: What does the psalm say the LORD does for the humble?
options: He fills the wealthy with good things
He arms the warriors for the battle
He adorns the humble with salvation
He crowns the mighty with great honor
questions.answer: He adorns the humble with salvation

questions.question: The psalm says let the godly exult in glory and sing for joy on their beds.
Sing to the LORD a new _____, his praise in the assembly of the godly!
For the LORD takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with _____.
